phases.title: Ship and verify
phases.summary: Nothing else can start until the press kit and prompts are live on the production domain.

tasks.title: Commit and deploy
tasks.detail: git commit → pnpm deploy → spot-check /press, /prompt, /prompt.txt on canmyagentuse.com

tasks.title: Verify social cards
tasks.detail: Paste /press and /prompt into a link-preview checker; both should show their 1200×630 cards

tasks.title: Google Search Console verified
tasks.detail: Domain property + submit sitemap.xml

tasks.title: Bing Webmaster Tools + IndexNow
tasks.detail: Bing feeds ChatGPT search and DuckDuckGo

tasks.title: press@canmyagentuse.com live
tasks.detail: Cloudflare Email Routing, ~10 minutes; then replace the “no press inbox yet” line in press.ts

tasks.title: Claim social handles
tasks.detail: X, LinkedIn company page, Bluesky, GitHub org — same mark, same boilerplate

tasks.title: Ship sameAs + logo in Organization JSON-LD
tasks.detail: Feeds Google's Knowledge Graph once profiles exist

phases.title: Owned surfaces
phases.summary: The site reports its own changes as dated news — use that machinery for the launch itself.

tasks.title: Launch post in content/news/en/
tasks.detail: Flows into RSS, JSON Feed, and llms.txt automatically

tasks.title: Founder posts on X and LinkedIn
tasks.detail: Founder voice outperforms brand voice at this stage

tasks.title: Create Wikidata item
tasks.detail: Independent compatibility catalog, inception 2026-08-28

tasks.title: Named editor on /about and news posts
tasks.detail: E-E-A-T: anonymous research catalogs rank and pitch worse

phases.title: Communities — free, highest expected value
phases.summary: One channel at a time, written natively for each. Answer questions; don't broadcast.

tasks.title: Show HN
tasks.detail: Tue–Thu 8–10am ET. Draft title is in the copy bank. Stay in the thread all day.

tasks.title: Product Hunt launch
tasks.detail: 12:01am PT, a few days after HN; PH pages rank for years

tasks.title: Lobsters
tasks.detail: The day after HN if it lands well

tasks.title: Reddit posts, spaced days apart
tasks.detail: r/LocalLLaMA, r/ClaudeAI, r/ChatGPTCoding, r/SideProject

tasks.title: Newsletter pitches
tasks.detail: Ben's Bites, TLDR AI, The Rundown, Latent Space — one stat + link to /press

tasks.title: MCP / Cursor / Claude / OpenAI dev Discords
tasks.detail: Share where capability questions get asked, as an answer not an ad

phases.title: Paid press release — one, budget tier
phases.summary: A wire buys legitimacy and a Google News footprint, not ranking links. Cap spend until metrics argue otherwise.

tasks.title: Pick the wire
tasks.detail: EIN Presswire ~$149 or eReleases ~$399; skip PR Newswire / Business Wire at this stage

tasks.title: Finalize release from the copy bank
tasks.detail: Recheck the numbers against /press before sending — they refresh at build

tasks.title: Send timed to the HN/PH week
10 direct journalist pitches
tasks.detail: Named AI/dev-tools reporters, using /press — one real story beats 400 syndications

phases.title: Directories and listings
phases.summary: Quality few, not mass submission. Skip bulk services — link farms hurt.

tasks.title: AI directories
tasks.detail: There's An AI For That, Toolify.ai, TopAI.tools free paths first

tasks.title: Dev directories
tasks.detail: AlternativeTo, SaaSHub, StackShare, LibHunt, Uneed, Peerlist Launchpad

tasks.title: llms.txt directories
tasks.detail: llmstxthub.com, llmstxt-site GitHub PR, llms-text.com — unusually on-brand

tasks.title: 3–5 awesome-list PRs
tasks.detail: awesome-ai-agents, awesome-mcp ecosystems, awesome-claude/chatgpt resources

phases.title: Durable ranking engine
phases.summary: The 125 × 31 capability matrix is programmatic SEO that already exists. Feed it.

tasks.title: Build embeddable README badges
tasks.detail: “MCP tools: yes — canmyagentuse.com” — every embed is a natural backlink

tasks.title: Quarterly “State of Agent Capabilities” report
tasks.detail: The classic linkable asset for newsletters and journalists

tasks.title: Weekly changes cadence
tasks.detail: Freshness signals plus a reason to re-cover

log.text: Open-data presence published: public GitHub repo canmyagentuse-data (CC BY 4.0, 10 topics, homepage set), Hugging Face dataset reachjalil/canmyagentuse with six viewer configs, and a static HF Space landing in the ledger style.
Report page issue tracker wired: PUBLIC_ISSUE_TRACKER_URL now points at the public data repo's issues. Press kit, llms.txt, and internal quick links cross-link the mirrors.
Catalog foundation, Evidence Atlas v1, harness columns, and unknown-by-default policy published.
Press kit (/press) and canonical prompts (/prompt, /prompt.txt) built with full machine-surface wiring, 10 brand guardrail tests, and social cards. Verified locally; not yet deployed.
